headline: What the statute bans

items.title: A semiautomatic, centerfire rifle with a detachable magazine and at least 2 of:
items.detail: folding or telescopic stock · thumbhole stock or pistol grip · forward or second grip · threaded barrel · shroud

items.title: The shroud clause, verbatim
items.detail: "a shroud that encircles either all or part of the barrel designed to shield the bearer's hand from heat"

sources: Sources: G.L. c.140, s.121, "Assault-style firearm" (accessed Sep 25, 2026)
